findings.evidence: scripts/release-repro.sh writes build-a and build-b as canonical artifact files directly beneath target/repro/build-a and target/repro/build-b, and release.yml copies that directory unchanged to m13-job/repro. scripts/release-aggregate.sh instead requires repro/build-a/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.2.28/release/oqueue and its build-b counterpart. tests/release-aggregate.sh constructs those same obsolete paths, so its green fixture cannot catch the production layout mismatch.
findings.summary: The native release aggregate looks for reproducibility outputs under the obsolete glibc-suffixed Cargo directory, so every valid M13 evidence bundle fails aggregation.
